A '''species''' of primitive [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Diet/Legends|omnivores]] evolved on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] had six [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] and were hunted by predators called [[Luprisi]] which they had to out smart to avoid. The species eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bosph (species)|Bosph]] species, who maintained their precursors species six limbs.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The precursor species to the Bosph was first mentioned in [[1997]], when author [[Trevor J. Wilson]] and [[Craig Robert Carey]] mentioned them in an entry in his article "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" as part of the Bosph section, published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' roleplaying supplement, published by [[West End Games]]. The article was republished in a reduced form, still mentioning the precursor species, in the book ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' in [[1998]], a collection of alien species compiled by [[Paul Sudlow]].
